test_dump_metric: test the dump_metric function writes valid JSONL records with metric name, value, and optional labels
test_dump_metric_bool_conversion: test the dump_metric function converts boolean values to integers when recording metrics
test_dump_metric_labels_stringification: test the dump_metric function stringifies non-serializable label objects
test_dump_metric_pytest_parsing: test the dump_metric function parses PYTEST_CURRENT_TEST env var for test_case field
test_dump_metric_no_env: test the dump_metric function skips file creation when SGLANG_TEST_METRICS_OUTPUT env var is unset
